description: Manually issue a permit token for an action. Use for pre-authorized operations where a full evaluate call is not practical.

context.description: Optional context to bind to the permit.

org_id.description: Organization ID that owns the policy.

resource.description: The resource the permit applies to (e.g. 'env:prod').

subject.description: The actor the permit is issued for (e.g. 'user:alice').

ttl_seconds.description: How long the permit is valid in seconds (default 300, max 86400).
